[1mDescription[22m:
Capture a screen recording from the preferred current device

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli capture record[22m

[1mOptions[22m:
  [1m-d, --device <device>[22m  Target device id
  [1m-o, --out <path>[22m       Local output path
  [1m--replace[22m              Replace an existing output file
  [1m-t, --time <seconds>[22m   Recording duration seconds (1-1800; longer requests are clamped to 1800)
                         (default: 15)
  [1m-h, --help[22m             Display this message
